statement.description: You have an unlimited supply of coins in n distinct denominations. Find the minimum number of coins needed to produce the target sum exactly.
statement.input: The first line contains n and x. The second line contains n distinct coin values.
statement.output: Print the minimum number of coins needed, or -1 if the target sum cannot be produced.

samples.explanation: The sum 11 can be produced as 5 + 5 + 1, using three coins.
